title: Studio pending changes: publishing a new object that has one authored field lists five system fields (created_at, created_by, owner_id, updated_at, updated_by) and the object's own label / name / nameField / sharingModel as "additions"
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (`@objectstack/console` 18.1.0)

Studio → new writable package → 新建对象 「报修工单」 (`repair_ticket`, OWD private) → 存为草稿 → 发布. The 待发布的变更 dialog expands the one object to:

```
对象 1 · 报修工单 · com_test_browser_repair_ticket · 新增
  + 创建时间 created_at
  + 创建人 created_by
  + 名称 name
  + 所有者 owner_id
  + 更新时间 updated_at
  + 更新人 updated_by
其他变更：
  + label
  + name
  + nameField
  + sharingModel
```

The author typed a display name and an identifier. The list tells them they are publishing six fields and four "other changes". [u16-publish-dialog.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/u16-publish-dialog.png); the collapsed form is fine: [u15-changes.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/u15-changes.png).

`reach:` the public UI, measured once; every first publish of a new object shows it.

## Expected

For a new object, the diff names what the author wrote (the object, its label, the authored fields) and folds the platform's system fields into one line (「含 5 个系统字段」); the object's own `label` / `name` / `nameField` / `sharingModel` are the object, not "other changes". objectstack-ai/objectui#13125 (closed) removed `__search` from the same list; this is the rest of that family.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "Studio publish changes list lists system fields created_at owner_id as additions for a new object" → 1 hit, objectstack-ai/objectui#13125 (closed, the `__search` row and API names), which did not cover system fields or the object attributes. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §7 S6.
